Friction Points Analysis

Based on the dataset summary and the detected global repetitions, the following are the top three friction points identified in the bus operator's workflow:

1. Viewed Hisab Page

  • Repetition Rate: 36.8%
  • Operational Impact: With 5361 total views, this suggests significant confusion or delay. If we assume an average time of 5 seconds per view, this results in approximately 298.4 hours wasted.
  • Probable Cause: The operator may be experiencing slow loading times or unclear navigation, leading them to repeatedly access the same page.
  • Solution: Optimize the loading speed of the Hisab page and improve the navigation structure to make it more intuitive.

2. Viewed Hisab Bus Detail

  • Repetition Rate: 21.3%
  • Operational Impact: With 3159 total views, this indicates a potential waste of approximately 175.5 hours if each view takes about 5 seconds.
  • Probable Cause: The operator might be unsure about the details presented or is facing delays in information retrieval.
  • Solution: Enhance the clarity of the bus detail information and ensure that data retrieval processes are optimized for speed.

3. Login Send OTP Failed

  • Repetition Rate: 13.3%
  • Operational Impact: Although only 15 total occurrences were noted, each failure could lead to significant frustration and time loss. Assuming each retry takes 10 seconds, this results in about 2.5 minutes wasted.
  • Probable Cause: This suggests issues with the OTP system, possibly due to network problems or user interface confusion.
  • Solution: Investigate the OTP delivery system for reliability and consider providing clearer feedback to the user regarding the status of their request.
